verdict.rationale: Pigment's Analyst Agent is documented as one that "continuously monitors your business" and surfaces "what matters," and variance analysis can flag the reasons behind gaps against budget. That hints at proactive metric surveillance, but the evidence never shows a threshold alert or push notification firing when a metric moves against plan. The only documented notifications are triggered manually by @-tagging a colleague, which is adjacent and not credited. Missing for 10: documented automatic alerts when a metric deviates from plan, configurable thresholds and delivery channels for those alerts, reporting-deadline reminders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform notifies me when a metric moves against plan or a reporting deadline approaches, before I ask

citations.quote: The Analyst Agent continuously monitors your business, uncovers what matters and builds reports from simple conversations
Run variance analysis on the same platform you build your budget. Understand and flag the reasons behind identified gaps
